scientific_integrity: Unrestricted finite-and-infinite cardinality theorem proved by symbolic induction; finite code checks are corroborative, not independent validation or a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: The fixed empty-state/singleton-state interpretation and unrestricted full powerset domain are essential; the result does not cover arbitrary propositional valuations, residuals, or finite-suprema iteration. Older modal-bisimulation or Boolean quantifier-elimination literature could subsume the theorem.
title: Sharp modal-depth cardinality types for binary-union information logic
